screen.mmm.quick_start.title: Matter, Motion & Mechanics Quick Start
screen.mmm.quick_start.step.1: 1. Gather iron, glass, redstone and lapis. Craft this guide from a book and glass pane, and the probe from a compass, glass pane, iron and redstone.
screen.mmm.quick_start.step.2: 2. Build a container from solid blocks and keep nearby chunks loaded. Sneak-use the probe on two corners around the container and its interior.
screen.mmm.quick_start.step.3: 3. Review the selected area and budget, then sneak-use again to create. Use the probe in the region to view and control it.
screen.mmm.quick_start.step.4: 4. Install a container port with the blue connector facing out. Use a water bucket on its front; sneak-use an empty material bucket to take a local sample.
screen.mmm.quick_start.step.5: 5. Sneak-use a filled container in air to inspect it and save a comparison baseline. A material box holds nine containers beside a port.
screen.mmm.quick_start.step.6: 6. Use the probe to configure port phase, direction, rate and redstone control. Cyan arrows feed inward, brass arrows extract outward, and neutral marks mean stopped.
screen.mmm.quick_start.step.7: 7. A sensor gauge faces out; its back is the default measurement point. Configure readings and thresholds with the probe. Sneak empty-handed for trends in simulation seconds.
screen.mmm.quick_start.step.8: 8. Control flow with valves and collect particles with screens. Before removing a region, administrators can preview and confirm emptying, venting and releasing ownership.

screen.mmm.demos.title: Demos
block.mmm.mechanical_driver.tooltip: Install in the region shell; use an empty hand to start, sneak-use to stop.
block.mmm.material_box.tooltip: Stores nine actual containers. Swap a held container, retrieve with an empty hand, or sneak empty-handed to select the next slot. Configure with the probe.
block.mmm.process_sensor.tooltip: Gauge faces out; the back is the default measurement point. Side arrows point toward it. Configure with the probe; sneak empty-handed for trends.
block.mmm.valve.tooltip: Empty-hand use cycles the opening. Configure with the probe; redstone strength controls the opening.
block.mmm.screen.tooltip: Retains particles above its pore size. Configure pores and open area with the probe; collect retained solids on the feed side.
block.mmm.insulating_glass.tooltip: Transparent block that blocks heat transfer.
block.mmm.metal_pipe.tooltip: A metal pipe with a 0.5 m bore. Sneak and use an end to cycle automatic, open and sealed.
block.mmm.insulated_pipe.tooltip: An insulated pipe with a 0.5 m bore. Sneak and use an end to cycle automatic, open and sealed.
block.mmm.glass_pipe.tooltip: A transparent pipe that conducts heat. Sneak and use an end to cycle automatic, open and sealed.
block.mmm.insulated_glass_pipe.tooltip: A transparent insulated pipe. Sneak and use an end to cycle automatic, open and sealed.
block.mmm.pipe_valve.tooltip: An axial pipe valve with closed, half-open and fully open positions. Right-click or use redstone.
block.mmm.pipe_screen.tooltip: An axial pipe screen. Use the field probe to configure its mesh.
screen.mmm.quick_start.step.9: 9. Place metal, insulated, glass or insulated glass pipes to build a route. The square bore is 0.5 m wide; the selected physical region must include the route and both vessels.
screen.mmm.quick_start.step.10: 10. Compatible pipe ends connect automatically. Sneak-use a pipe face to cycle automatic, open and sealed. An open end connects to liquid or air in the same region.
screen.mmm.quick_start.step.11: 11. The pipe valve has closed, half-open and fully open settings. Right-click to change its opening or control it with redstone. A pipe screen accepts the same probe configuration as a screen.
screen.mmm.quick_start.step.12: 12. Metal and glass pipes conduct heat; insulated metal and insulated glass pipes block heat transfer. Glass pipes let you inspect the contents. Open the Demos menu for ready-made examples.
